principle: Seed namespaces are valid draft and setup memory surfaces. During maturation, reviewed summaries may be copied, linked, or superseded by operational namespaces after approval and policy checks.

mappings.activation_condition: Owner-reviewed identity purpose, profile, tone, or operating constraints become durable identity history.
Profile history remains stable across lifecycle modes.
Draft research is source-reviewed and associated with the matured identity domain.
Draft knowledge is reviewed, scored, and approved for operational guidance.
Gap records remain useful as maturation evidence.
Inactive proposals are reviewed; approved and activated capabilities move to the relevant proposal or activation namespace.
Review outcomes become durable approval context without exposing private verification evidence.
Runtime usage events continue and may be summarized into rollups.
Conversation summaries become operational memory only after domain, audience, and privacy policy are approved.
Audience notes become customer/user memory only after the matured identity has an approved audience model.
Approved preferences become route-scoped operational preference memory.
